title: mind the jumps: a scalable robust local gaussian process for multidimensional response surfaces with discontinuities
core_idea: Proposes the robust local Gaussian process (rlgp) framework that combines adaptive nearest-neighbor selection with a sparsity-driven, optimization-based mean-shift robustification applied after a multivariate perspective transformation, together with local neighborhood modeling, to handle nonstationary multidimensional response surfaces with abrupt jumps and outliers.
tldr: Introduce rlgp: a scalable approach that fuses perspective transformation, adaptive local GP neighborhoods, and sparsity-based mean-shift robustification to model discontinuous, nonstationary response surfaces.
